name: zoho-lead-profiler
description: Researches specific leads the user names in Zoho CRM for a payroll company — never auto-selecting them. Verifies purchased ZoomInfo data against better sources — still employed there, title current, phone and email right. Finds the top decision-maker — owner, founder, partner, else CEO or president — and makes them the primary contact; when they have no direct phone, keeps them primary and adds a reachable senior second in the additional-contact fields. Digs deep, with a completion bar per lead
